subject: math
title: Hundreds, tens and ones
canDo: I can say what each digit in a 3-digit number is worth.

subject: math
title: Compare and order numbers to 1,000
canDo: I can compare and order numbers up to 1,000.

subject: math
title: Round to the nearest 10 or 100
titleId: Membulatkan ke puluhan atau ratusan terdekat
canDo: I can round a number to the nearest 10 or 100.

subject: math
title: Counting in steps, odd and even numbers
titleId: Membilang loncat, bilangan ganjil dan genap
canDo: I can count on and back in steps and tell odd numbers from even numbers.

subject: math
title: Add and subtract in your head
canDo: I can add and subtract 2-digit and 3-digit numbers in my head.

subject: math
title: Column addition and subtraction
canDo: I can add and subtract 3-digit numbers in columns.

subject: math
title: Times tables for 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 8, 9 and 10
canDo: I can recall the 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 8, 9 and 10 times tables.

subject: math
title: Division facts and remainders
canDo: I can divide using times tables and find what is left over.

subject: math
title: Multiply a 2-digit number by a 1-digit number
titleId: Mengalikan bilangan 2 angka dengan bilangan 1 angka
canDo: I can multiply a 2-digit number by a 1-digit number by splitting it into tens and ones.

subject: math
title: Unit and non-unit fractions
canDo: I can name and shade fractions of shapes and groups.

subject: math
title: Fractions of amounts
canDo: I can find a fraction of an amount by sharing it into equal groups.

subject: math
title: Equivalent fractions and comparing fractions
canDo: I can find fractions that are equal and say which fraction is bigger.

subject: math
title: Money: totals and change in rupiah
titleId: Uang: jumlah dan kembalian dalam rupiah
canDo: I can add up prices and work out change in rupiah.

subject: math
title: Tell the time to 5 minutes
canDo: I can read and show the time to the nearest 5 minutes.

subject: math
title: Time intervals and calendars
canDo: I can work out how long something takes and use a calendar.

subject: math
title: Length in centimetres and metres
canDo: I can measure lengths and change metres into centimetres.

subject: math
title: Mass and capacity
canDo: I can read scales in grams, kilograms, millilitres and litres.

subject: math
title: Temperature in degrees Celsius
canDo: I can read a thermometer and compare temperatures.

subject: math
title: Perimeter and area on a grid
titleId: Keliling dan luas pada kertas berpetak
canDo: I can find the perimeter and the area of shapes on a square grid.

subject: math
title: 2D shapes and their properties
canDo: I can name 2D shapes and count their sides, vertices and right angles.

subject: math
title: 3D shapes: faces, edges and vertices
titleId: Bangun ruang: sisi, rusuk, dan titik sudut
canDo: I can name 3D shapes and count their faces, edges and vertices.

subject: math
title: Lines of symmetry
canDo: I can find vertical and horizontal lines of symmetry in shapes and letters.

subject: math
title: Right angles and turns
canDo: I can compare angles with a right angle and describe quarter, half and whole turns.

subject: math
title: Position, direction and movement
canDo: I can use north, south, east and west to describe a position and a route.

subject: math
title: Tally charts and frequency tables
canDo: I can read and use tally charts and frequency tables.

subject: math
title: Pictograms and bar charts
canDo: I can read pictograms and bar charts that use a key or a scale.

subject: math
title: Venn and Carroll diagrams
canDo: I can sort numbers into Venn and Carroll diagrams.

subject: math
title: Certain, likely, unlikely, impossible
titleId: Pasti, kemungkinan besar, kemungkinan kecil, mustahil
canDo: I can describe how likely something is to happen.
